item.title: Productivity bonuses in Italy: the 1% flat tax Nordic employers should know
item.description: In 2026 Italian productivity bonuses up to €5,000 a year can be taxed at 1% under a qualifying company plan. How it works and how it differs from a normal bonus.

item.title: Lunch benefit, Italian style: meal vouchers and fringe benefits in 2026
item.description: Electronic meal vouchers are tax-free up to €10 a day in Italy in 2026; fringe benefits up to €1,000 a year, €2,000 with children. How Nordic employers use them.

item.title: Occupational pension at home, INPS and TFR in Italy: the pension layer explained
item.description: Nordic employers fund pensions through statutory and agreement-based schemes. In Italy the employer pays 23.81% for the state pension, plus the TFR. How to budget it.
